name: Catholic Academic Exchange Service (KAAD): Eastern Europe Programme
summary: The KAAD is the scholarship institution of the catholic Church in Germany. Applicants for this programme are from Central, Eastern and South-east Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia , are proficient in German and are of catholic faith. In
